ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35% high-intensity (white) to 65% low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white patch on the proximal left lobe; scattered white circular rosettes (diameters 5-15 pixels) across central and right black regions; thin white banding along the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped indentation with an estimated 65-degree interior angle and a depth of approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serrated profile with high-frequency peaks (5-20 pixel amplitude) along the entire trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory from the median notch to the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dozens of circular, high-contrast white rings/spots (barnacle scars) distributed across the dark regions of both lobes, particularly dense on the inner right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel vertical white rake marks (approx. 50-80 pixels in length) visible on the lower-left ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular barnacle scarring and linear rake marks are present across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Clusters of large, protruding barnacle organisms are attached to the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
